context.body: Peace and diplomacy make construction possible through a vast labor system.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Solomon and Hiram arrange timber, food, skilled work, forced labor, and stone preparation for the Temple.
observations.label: Solomon contracts for cedar and labor: action

observations.body: Israelites, Sidonians, carriers, quarrymen, and supervisors sustain the project.
observations.label: Solomon contracts for cedar and labor: response

observations.body: cedar · forced labor · thirty thousand · great stones
observations.label: Words in 1 Kings 5:1–18

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 5:1–18 as building the house evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: A house for God is built through burdens whose distribution the account records but does not evaluate here.
payload.title: Solomon contracts for cedar and labor
